stem.text: Two springs X and Y stretch elastically. The graphs show the variation with extension $x$ of the force $F$ applied to each spring.

stem.alt: Graph of F/N against x/cm for spring X; vertical axis marked 0 and 20, horizontal axis marked 0 and 10; a straight line from the origin.
Graph of F/N against x/cm for spring Y; vertical axis marked 0 and 80, horizontal axis marked 0 and 5; a straight line from the origin.

A.text: When each spring is given the same extension, the energy stored in Y is $4$ times the energy stored in X.

B.text: When each spring is given the same extension, the energy stored in Y is $8$ times the energy stored in X.

C.text: When the same force is applied to each spring, the energy stored in Y is $4$ times the energy stored in X.

D.text: When the same force is applied to each spring, the energy stored in Y is $8$ times the energy stored in X.
